Title: Eyelids heavy 20 minutes after lunch? Look at your desk lunch

Description:
High-glycemic foods spike blood sugar fast, so insulin floods in and can overshoot, crashing sugar below where it started — that crash cuts glucose to your brain and triggers the fatigue. Fatty foods work differently, linked to a hormone called cholecystokinin that acts on the vagus nerve and brings on sleepiness.

The classic American lunch — a sandwich on white bread, a bag of chips, and a can of soda — hits both mechanisms at once. Watch to see why each one matters and what to swap in instead.

Eyelids getting heavy 20 minutes after lunch? 😴

High-glycemic foods spike blood sugar fast then crash it hard, and fatty foods trigger a hormone that makes you sleepy on their own. The classic American lunch — white bread sandwich, chips, soda — hits both at once.

Swap white bread for whole grain, chips for nuts, soda for unsweetened iced tea — one swap at a time makes the crash way easier to handle.
